reviews.text: Finding a great groomer has been a long journey, but this place nailed it! The experience was amazing and they did a fantastic job. They even threw in a nail trim, which I didn't expect. My dog looks incredible (even if he refuses to pose for the camera). Highly recommend—we'll definitely be returning clients!
Excellent service, very friendly staff, I highly recommend it to everyone ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
My 7lb chihuahua will not let anyone including the vet cut her nails EXCEPT this place. In and out in 5 min.
Absolutely hands down the best grooming place around! The staff are respectful, on point, polite, and talented. Their work is perfectly artistic and they treat pets with care. Highly recommend!
Love their service. They groom my cat so nicely and he’s always clean and fresh after a visit.
I will let y'all know I'm using this place for the first time the price quote was acceptable

My Yorkie got her haircut—it turned out absolutely wonderful. She turned out so neat, with her bow and earrings—she's a real beauty! 🐾 What a great team of professionals! You clearly love animals and know your stuff. Thank you so much, we'll definitely be back!
They get my baby’s cut every time. He’s a Pomeranian and I am really picky!
Good kind and friendly service

This is the only place I bring my dog. Any time I’ve strayed away from Alex, I’ve regretted it and left the grooming place crying lol. He does a perfect job shaping his paws and face and gets the coat length down perfectly every single time. Plus super friendly and kind staff and my dog isn’t as anxious to go in here as he is other salons. Thank you!!!

the place is very cool. and the owners (mother and son).  they do the work 100% ,and they do it very well ,  very quickly with high quality .and I had a new cat, he feels great and does not hold evil workers)))I will recommend this place with great pleasure and have already given the phone number to all my  friends who have cats.

The experience was excellent, my dog Bella I got her from the shelter and she’s not really exposed to others so when I took her here she really did show out but the workers were very nice and worked with me to get Bella all nice and clean and I really appreciate it.
Michael is very friendly and they did an excellent job with our toy poodle Ella!

They took the time to understand my cat’s needs and delivered a fabulous grooming. My cat looks stunning and seems much more comfortable. I highly recommend their services to anyone looking for a caring and professional groomer!
